categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds CI configuration and scripts under .github/ (.github/workflows/silent-merge-check.yml and helper python scripts).
categories.rationale: Adds a periodic GitHub Actions workflow to detect silent semantic merge conflicts across open PRs by building and testing them every six hours. While helpful for reducing contributor friction by identifying broken merge commits before review or merge, it is an automated tooling convenience rather than a fix for release integrity, supported-platform breakage, or core CI reliability.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' by maintainers; automates running the test suite against pre-built merge commits for open pull requests.
categories.rationale: Provides earlier test signal by automatically detecting semantic merge breakages on open PRs. It improves feedback on test status across branches, but operates as CI orchestration rather than improving test coverage or test framework capabilities.
